claim: If you delegate a domain or subdomain to Route 53 name servers before you create a corresponding hosted zone, this creates dangling delegation records, and Route 53 cannot protect against this. To mitigate the risk, only delegate to Route 53 name servers that belong to a public hosted zone that you control.

evidence.quote: Route 53 cannot protect against this because no hosted zone has ever existed to establish a hold on those name servers for that domain name. To mitigate the risk, only delegate to Route 53 name servers that belong to a public hosted zone that you control.
You delegate a domain or subdomain to Route 53 name servers before creating a corresponding hosted zone, this creates dangling delegation records.
